environment.dependencies: Node built-in modules only for the traceability checks

red.failingTest: every executable .NET harness case must retain a traceability mapping
red.behaviouralFixture: Remove DDD-STATE-01 from scenarios and all criterion backlinks while leaving the declared .NET harness case present.
red.missingBehaviourAtRun: The checker validated each mapped case but did not compare the entire harness case set with the traceability case set.

green.metadataLimitation: The orchestrating tool printed only command output for this run; individual exec metadata was not preserved in its visible result.
green.implementedBehaviour: Compare all declared .NET harness case IDs with all mapped contract-example IDs and reject missing or duplicate mappings.

preservation.source: Original tool-visible stdout/stderr text retained in the completed Codex conversation
preservation.representation: Manually preserved transcript copies; not original byte-for-byte process stream files
preservation.sanitisation: Absolute user/workspace prefixes in stack trace file URLs replaced with [repository]/; test names, results, errors and command semantics retained

assessmentLimits: Shows this specific traceability-checker behavioural RED/GREEN sequence.
Does not supply a historical immutable Git SHA or precise timestamp; neither was recorded.
A later commit preserving these records does not retroactively identify the original tested tree.
Does not verify production APIs, PostgreSQL isolation, mobile devices, routing providers, restore operations or a working TMS.
